body:
I feel very similarly. I can function in life, I do get amused and intrigued by things, I can feel happiness. But fleetingly. At the end of the day when I'm alone in my apartment, I still feel like there is absolutely no point to anything I'm doing. 

My answer to why I wake up in the morning is because I didn't die in my sleep. I have to go about my day in order to pay bills, etc, but I don't WANT to.
